_comment: Advisory channel binding, disabled. Carries no secret and never will: apiKeyEnv names the environment variable the key is read from, and the key itself lives in the adopter's own credential store. Turning `enabled` on sends the conversation — the user's turns and the replies to them, tool calls excluded — to `endpoint` on every prompt; read the advisory section of route/README.md before doing so. stateTokenBudget is how much of that conversation is offered, under the endpoint's own 32k state ceiling.
